assumptions: 'verify recommended products order in ${variable}' is assumed to accept a comma-separated list of ordered group/type labels and compare it against the framework's internal representation of the actual carousel ordering; exact label vocabulary (WITH_DS_WITHIN_CITY, 360_VIDEO, WITH_PRICE, etc.) is inferred from the ticket's own hierarchy naming and may need alignment with the automation framework's real label set.
'verify recommended products carousel order on page' is assumed to perform a holistic validation of the full DS+city+price+DS-type hierarchy without needing an explicit expected-order variable.
'verify recommended products prefer search city on page' is assumed to validate that search-city-origin products rank ahead of other-city products within the same DS/price bucket.

Ask For Price lead submission flow may prompt for mobile number / OTP verification before the GBP sheet can be submitted; this was not detailed in the ticket, so the flow assumes it can complete without extra verification, or that the user is already authenticated.

Product category test URL (Dehradun/Fabrication-Contractors) and service category test URL (Delhi/CNG-Cylinder-Testing-Services) from GJDT-22698/22699 are used as the primary happy-path pages; Bulk SMS Services and Steel Merchants URLs are used specifically for their respective defect/concern regressions.

unclear: AC10 ('the existing logic for determining whether an individual product/service qualifies should remain unchanged') is not independently testable via UI steps since it concerns backend eligibility logic already covered by API sub-task GJDT-22695; no dedicated testcase was written for it beyond the ordering testcases which implicitly exercise the same qualified candidate set.

GJDT-22703 is a 'Concern' ticket asking for clarification on ordering of non-search cities, not a confirmed defect with an expected fix; the written testcase asserts general hierarchy consistency but the exact expected ordering among multiple outside cities (e.g., Indore vs Bangalore vs Delhi vs Chittorgarh) was never specified by the reporter or resolved in comments.
